Durable Agents: checkpointing long-running LLM agents

1 Introduction

Long-running agents lose their state when a process crashes. We propose a harness that checkpoints every tool call and replays the log on restart, so that runs survive failures. Code is available at our repository.

2 Method

Each step writes an event to an append-only log; on restart, the harness replays the log and resumes from the last completed step, which keeps tool calls idempotent.
